rules: validation/m6-vm-limits.json, committed before any run and not changed

guest.account: made by a person in macOS setup

cause_of_the_failures.summary: The GPU in the guest does not have what these libraries need. No part reached a wrong result: each one refused the device.
cause_of_the_failures.mlx: Runs on the device: default device gpu, and a 1000x1000 matmul finished. Whether its results are right on this device was not compared.
cause_of_the_failures.f3: cumlx kernel verify runs through PyTorch MPS. torch says: Skipping device Apple Paravirtual device that does not support Metal 2.0. The command gave exit 3 with: PyTorch has no MPS device or no compile_shader, so the kernel cannot run. So the kernels were not graded here.
cause_of_the_failures.f4: Genesis says: Backend gs.metal not available on this machine. So training did not start. Memory was not the cause.
cause_of_the_failures.f5: Mitsuba says: skipping device Apple Paravirtual device because it does not support Metal 3.

network.finding: The guest reached its gateway and DNS, and no address beyond them. The host reached the internet. The cause was not found: Tailscale runs on the host and is a suspect, and it was not switched off to test that.
network.what_was_done: CUMLX_VM_PROXY=1: a web proxy on the host loopback, for ports 80 and 443 only, over ssh -R. No setting on the host changed.

earlier_runs_not_counted: No internet: the guest ended at the command line tools with a misleading verdict, setup_error_no_command_line_tools_label.
A verdict that the first run left in the guest was read as this run's. That was a bug in the script, now fixed.
what_this_shows: The public repository installs from nothing in a fresh macOS 27.2 VM, and the base passes there: doctor, self test, and the tests without a GPU.
what_this_does_not_show: F3, F4 and F5 on another machine. This VM cannot run them, so this route cannot answer that.
That another macOS VM tool differs. Tart uses the same Virtualization framework and was not run; the same limit is likely, and it is not measured.
F1 and F2. They have no reproduced run on any machine.
